01How do I choose the best orthodontist in Islamabad for my needs?

Look for relevant qualifications, a clear explanation of your options, and a plan for follow-up care. A consultation with Dr. Adeel Zia lets you discuss your goals, ask questions and understand your treatment before deciding.

02How much do braces cost in Islamabad?

Fees depend on your alignment needs, appliance choice and treatment plan. Request a consultation for an individual quote, including what is covered by visits and retainers.

03Are clear aligners right for me?

An orthodontic examination is needed to check suitability. Your bite, tooth movement needs and ability to follow the wear schedule all matter. We can discuss aligners alongside braces.

04Can adults have orthodontic treatment?

Yes, adults can explore orthodontic care. Your teeth and gum health will be assessed before a suitable treatment approach is recommended.

05Where is the clinic, and when can I visit?

Find us at Melody Market, Civic Centre, Municipal Road, G-6 Markaz, Islamabad. Our listed hours are Monday to Saturday, 2:00 PM–9:00 PM. Contact us to confirm your appointment before visiting.
